notes: Source: ELMO USA official product page (elmousa.com/product/mo-2), the manufacturer's own regional distributor site — treated as authoritative for I/O list. Manufacturer does not publish HDMI version, USB speed class, or exact DC power connector shape, so no bandwidth grades were set on HDMI/USB/Ethernet ports per instructions (grade omitted where unstated). DC In is listed as "DC5V In" with an external AC adapter (model TT-12W) and an internal ~3-hour battery; connector mapped to dc-barrel as the closest match in the allowed list, but exact physical connector shape (barrel vs proprietary) could not be confirmed. B&H spec page returned HTTP 403 and could not be used as a secondary cross-check; Markertek page fetched resolved to their homepage, not the product spec page. No rack-mount info — this is a desktop/portable folding document camera (visual presenter), not rack-mountable.

ports.name: USB (Type B)

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: DC 5V input; powered via included AC adapter (TT-12W) or internal battery (~3hr runtime). Physical connector style not explicitly confirmed as barrel — closest match from connector list.
